scope: Portable canonical identity, immutable sealing, evaluation and deployment development build; CPU only. Not the published 2.4.0 release.
host_isolation: Shared host; no other DEEPBOM build or test was launched during these benchmark trials. Unrelated host activity is uncontrolled.
aggregation: Median of three timings; maximum of 10 ms sampled RSS per condition. Raw per-run observations retained.
